name: kids-ai-studio
description: Produtora de vídeos infantis educativos - desenvolvimento local com motor de animação 2D e exportação MP4 via FFmpeg

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w apps/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/frontend
